name: SPY call spread variant: weekly ladder, 30 days, 50% stop
note: From the tune: a new $10 spread that costs $5.00 every week, one monthly expiration out, close at $9.90 / 50% stop / expiry, no trend filter; four to five spreads open at once (10% of the account at risk in total). Four times the trades of the monthly routine, so its numbers rest on more evidence.
